items.title: What are the six layers of the stablecoin stack and which should you build?
items.snippet: Most confusion about “which stablecoin company does what” comes from treating stablecoins as a single product and they are not. The market has settled into a six-layer stack and companies win by developing depth in one or two layers, not by trying to own all six. Layer 1 Blockchain. Ethereum, Solana, Tron, Polygon, Base, Avalanche. Settlement rails. Equivalent to SWIFT, ACH, or the card networks, but open-source and global by default.
